content.short: Proofivy provides onchain IP, copyright, and ideas.
content.description: Proofivy delivers robust proof of ownership for digital content, helping creators, innovators, and professionals safeguard their work. It offers easy-to-use apps across devices and platforms, enabling straightforward registration, verification, and protection of rights for art, writing, software, and other digital assets. Used by artists, writers, and developers, Proofivy builds durable, verifiable ownership records that support licensing, attribution, and secure sharing of creations.
